alt.en: A large orange location pin stands at the center of a gray floor. A dashed orange line with two packets runs to its tip from a gray globe on the left, and a teal arrow runs from the pin to a teal tool tile with a terminal icon on the right.
alt.zh: 灰色地面中央立着一枚大号橙色定位针。左侧灰色地球仪引出一条带两个数据包的橙色虚线，通到针尖；一条青色箭头再从定位针指向右侧带终端图标的青色工具牌。

caption.en: Illustration: a location pin marks the spot where an injected instruction lands on its way from an agent's environment, drawn as a globe, to a tool call, drawn as a tool tile. It does not depict a tested deployment, the paper's testbeds or any measured result.
caption.zh: 示意图：定位针标出注入指令落下的位置，它处在智能体所处环境（地球仪）与工具调用（工具牌）之间。本图并未描绘任何经过测试的部署，也不代表论文的测试环境或实测结果。
